findings.problem: Confirmed directory pages/cursor erased during preparation or failed refresh; duplicate reads.
findings.fix: Scoped preparation, shared pending first page, preserve confirmed cursor on failure and preserve pages after read-only return.

findings.problem: Fresh memberships could skip replacement of an already-known organization.
findings.fix: Replace organizations by refreshed IDs as well as previous memberships.

findings.problem: Deleted profile remained cached/actionable; opening detail did not refresh the profile.
findings.fix: Fresh selected-profile read, explicit unavailable state, no action controls for removed accounts.

findings.problem: Action sheet target/actor was derived again while presented.
findings.fix: Freeze target/actor snapshot, gate confirmation by current revision/permissions; scrollable frozen ownership confirmation.

findings.problem: Audit-history refresh could be lost behind an older isLoading request; paging retry restarted from page one.
findings.fix: Scoped store, replacement request for changed refresh token, retained confirmed data and exact failed-page retry.

findings.problem: Chronological orderBy excludes legacy users without createdAt.
findings.fix: First-page coverage check; opaque cursor retains legacy fallback; no invented creation dates. Normal indexed pages projected to createdAt.

findings.problem: Duplicate detail/security reads; a caller could finish before shared metadata arrived.
findings.fix: Coalesce reads and await shared result, fence changed sessions and post-mutation profiles.

findings.problem: Membership failure looked like confirmed no memberships; failed organization-choice refresh cleared choices.
findings.fix: Per-user loading/confirmed/error state, coalesced memberships, explicit retry, retain confirmed choices/cursor.

findings.problem: Maximum-text role forms had nested combined controls and inaccessible picker identifiers.
findings.fix: Independent assignment card, adaptive menu layout, full-height form, stable nonlocalized IDs, busy state through readback.

findings.problem: List organization badge subtracted the primary role but label read as a total (8 for 9 organizations).
findings.fix: Show the full membership count, including a single organization.

findings.problem: Whole audit-card accessibility identifier hid descendant paging/retry identifiers.
findings.fix: Independent action identifiers; static history records combined into coherent accessibility elements.

findings.problem: A linked organization could be evicted by a later feed replacement and the detail remained in loading state.
findings.fix: Actor-scoped bounded detail cache independent of public feed; interactions update cache without leaking out-of-page entries; clear on logout, visibility denial and deletion.

findings.problem: Server audit values include ISO strings and nulls; expiry, warning count and ownership changes were not presented completely.
findings.fix: Localized expiry values, honest empty values, before/after warning counts and owner identifiers.

findings.problem: Initial profile failure displayed the same message twice; directory summary continued to say it was searching after failure.
findings.fix: One profile failure with targeted retry; no ongoing-search copy after a completed failed request; plain list-error wording in uk/de/en.

visualReview.remaining: Final wording-only physical copy readback pending device availability; relevant functional physical and simulator visuals reviewed.

fixtureLessons: The old owner fixture had requiresMultiFactorAuth absent. The missing-factor test must use an explicitly protected admin, preserving the existing migration/bootstrap policy rather than changing auth policy in this audit.
Fixtures must use Timestamp for createdAt and the requested user ID, matching live readers.
A zero-case Swift Testing selection is not a pass; explicit full suites executed.
Shared emulator namespaces can contaminate unfiltered totals. Separate projects; scope owned-role fixtures by prefix. Search benchmark rerun on fresh fixed namespace.
Legal evidence search intentionally returns totalMatches=null with bounded accounts. Update legacy test expectation and assert exact returned IDs; do not restore a full scan.
Readback allowlist must explicitly include only GET of the owned organization before running a connected mutation.
An organization cloned from the earlier fixture must synchronize localizations as well as raw name. A raw-name repository assertion cannot substitute for the displayed localized heading.
Scroll through a free gutter when a large multiline native input occupies the drag origin. Do not change production deadlines or expected business data to hide driver errors.
Parent accessibility identifiers can replace descendant identifiers. Keep independent paging/actions and combine static history records only.

delivery.finalPhysicalBinary: Functional signed Release installed/read successfully; final wording-only a921224d Release built, device unavailable for final installation/readback.

verificationPending: Physical iPhone unavailable on 2026-10-26; final wording-only a921224d Release installation/readback pending. Earlier functional physical read passed.
verificationBoundaries: All applicable authorization branches are covered by source/contract/unit/actual-handler checks; representative UI is reused for the same shared layout. This is not a claim of a physical-device session for each role and each cross-product.
Physical production reads use only Serlest; account sanctions, role and ownership mutations use fixed isolated demo data. No real account sanctions/role/ownership changes.
Auth Emulator lacks real TOTP; the connected privileged-review fixture supplies a fixed demo-only factor assertion. Production MFA/provider behavior was not changed.
Push routing/recipient isolation and duplicate suppression are tested with mocked transport. New APNs delivery to a physical recipient is not claimed; APNs sender unchanged.

Status/name sorts and organization-role filters may stream compact server candidates. The common chronological list and ready indexed search are bounded/indexed; do not describe every filter as constant-cost.
No registration, credential creation/deletion, TestFlight upload or public release in this block.
